verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only qualitative marketing claims (FP8 Transformer Engine, RT Cores, memory bandwidth, PCIe Gen5) and community pricing/power discussions, but no actual TFLOPS/TOPS figures broken out by precision (FP8/FP16/INT8) or with sparsity stated — the exact 'bare marketing number' problem the story asks to avoid. No spec sheet or datasheet citation with concrete throughput numbers is present.
